newsitem.title: USA: Allied Waste delays acquisitions until '97.
newsitem.headline: Allied Waste delays acquisitions until '97.

text.p: Allied Waste Industries Inc on Friday said it would delay several planned acquisitions until the first quarter of 1997 while it completes its purchase of Laidlaw Inc's solid-waste operations.

The deals, intitially planned for the third and fourth quarters of 1996, were factored into earnings guidance that Allied offered to financial analysts before it entered into the Laidlaw deal in September, Chief Financial Officer Henry Hirvela told Reuters.
